Name: Asters Royalcore Custom Picture Frames
Author: Asterisk555
Description:
[u]Description:[/u]
[list]
[*]Content pack for Custom Picture Frames
[*]Adds several royalcore themed picture frames
[*]Take pictures in-game and display them on your walls!
[*]If you like this you could buy me a [url=https://ko-fi.com/asteriskart]coffee[/url]﻿ to show your support
[/list]
[u]To start:[/u]
[list=1]
[*]Extract this mod and it's required mods into your mods folder (if you are confused check out [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Getting_started]this guide[/url]﻿)
[*]Launch the game
[*]Buy picture frames at Robin's Carpenter shop
[*]Press f10 to start taking a picture to put in your frame, press f11 to switch between different frames, press f12 to take a picture (might need to also press fn depending on your computer. It's also possible to change the hot keys in the Custom Picture Frames config file)
[*]Put the frame on your wall and hover over it and press f11 until you find the picture you want
[/list]
[u]Tips and tricks[/u][list]
[*]The CustomPictureFrames mod save your images whether you save the day or not
[*]Since each save file has it's own album in the "CustomPictureFrames" folder you can try making your own art and putting it in the folder. This is how I managed to get higher resolution art in my screenshots, if you use the game's internal screenshot feature make sure to set the zoom level of the screenshot to 100% or it'll get pixelated. This trick won't work with the frame that hangs on the beam though, and this is not a bug cause the framework wasn't intended to be used this way anyway.
[/list]
